name: Benamejí (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, crimson above and dark blue below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Benamejí (a cross of Saint James on white above a castle on red).
history: Municipal flag of Benamejí; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Benamejí arms — cross of Saint James above a castle
